name: Mother Amanita
description: A towering red-capped Fungril hag who fills the battlefield with poisonous spores and waking nightmares.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: Mother Amanita can be spotlighted up to twice per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual.

abilities.name: Toxic Bloom
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. All PCs within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (14). On a failure, they take 2d6+3 magic damage and mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Nightmare Spores
abilities.description: Spend a Fear and choose a target within Far range. They must make a Presence Reaction Roll (15). On a failure, they become Vulnerable and have disadvantage on their next action roll as horrifying hallucinations overwhelm them. Both effects end after that roll.

abilities.name: Feed on Terror
abilities.description: When a PC within Far range marks Stress because of one of Mother Amanita’s features, Mother Amanita may clear a Stress.

abilities.name: My Sister Will Not Die
abilities.description: When Mother Cordyceps would mark her last HP while the Cocoon is alive, spend 2 Fear. The Cocoon immediately uses Life-Giving Spores on Cordyceps before the damage resolves.
